instruction.text: Decide whether the adverb describes certainty or uncertainty.
Listen to the sentences and decide if the adverbs make them certain or uncertain.

atoms.sound: Don’t worry, I will definitely be there tomorrow.
Maybe if James comes we can all go to the park together.
Obviously my mum will give us some advice if it goes wrong.
Could you possibly help me with this?
Perhaps we should have told the truth sooner.
Surely Mark will be able to find another way.
Leah will certainly be more excited than Lucy was.
It is unlikely to rain, but bring a coat just in case.
